actions.enhance: Quality-only pass. Never change text, facts, people, objects, logos or documentary meaning.
actions.localize: Translate explanatory text faithfully into the target language. Preserve factual relationships and identifiers. For authorized edits preserve people and documentary content; for unlicensed information graphics create a new original redraw.
actions.recreate: Create a new original informational visual from verified facts. Never reconstruct real documentary scenes or real people as photographs.
actions.clean_recreate: Create a NEW original visual without channel promotion or attribution noise. Do not erase or patch watermarks on the source image.
actions.info_card: Create a clearly non-documentary original information card with an honest factual headline/hook and visual hierarchy.
actions.generate: Create an original X illustration/information card from the verified packet and final editorial angle, even without source images.
actions.text_only: Deliver the existing text draft without images.

options.keep_identifiers: Preserve relevant numbers, dates, products/models, protocols and technical identifiers verbatim.
options.translate_text: Translate explanatory image text to the selected locale, preserving meaning.
options.similar_layout: Prefer similar informational hierarchy; layout similarity is a preference, never a factual verification criterion for original redraws.
options.redesign: Allow a completely new original layout and visual hierarchy.
options.remove_overlays: Exclude channel/promotion overlays from NEW creations. Never erase watermarks on a source edit.
options.factual_priority: Prioritize factual accuracy over decorative detail.
options.visual_priority: Prioritize visual clarity, quality and mobile readability; never invent facts for aesthetics.
options.minimal_changes: Minimize changes consistent with the action, target language and mandatory safety rules.
options.info_card_fallback: Only when explicitly enabled, use a NEW verified-facts information card if a local promotion edit is unsafe. This fallback is not a minimal edit to the original.

densities.low: One core idea, an honest short hook/headline and minimal text. No more than one supporting label.
densities.medium: A short factual headline/hook plus 2–4 high-value points if supported; fewer if the packet has fewer facts.
densities.high: More technical detail is allowed, but use short labels and grouped cards. Keep readable font sizes on a mobile X feed. Never dense paragraphs.
